For  decades,  humans  have  tried  to  theorise  the  origin  and evolution  of  the  universe.  Many  theories  have  been  proposed and  rejected.  However,  the  Big Bang theory has been the most (388)  ______  accepted.  According  to  this  theory,  the  universe began  as a single point, or singularity, around 13.8 billion years ago.  This  singularity  contained  all  the  matter  and  energy  that would eventually (389)______ the  stars,  galaxies  and  other structures that make up our universe today. The Big Bang theory is supported by a (390)______ of observational evidence, including the cosmic  microwave  background  radiation,  the (391)______ of light elements in the universe and the large-scale structure  of  the  cosmos.  Despite  its  success,  the  Big  Bang theory is still an active area of research, with scientists seeking to  better  understand  the  earliest  moments of the universe and the (392)______ of dark matter and energy.
Q.388. (a) loosely   (b) largely   (c) widely    (d) vastly
